title: Double Kettlebell Complex №1
description: Perform the complex with two kettlebells without resting between exercises. Rest only after completing a full round. The exercises sequentially engage the chest, back, shoulders, arms, legs, and core, while developing strength, muscular endurance, coordination, and the ability to work the entire body as one system. Weight Selection: Choose a kettlebell weight that allows you to perform 6–8 repetitions of each exercise with proper form.

title: Double Kettlebell Complex № 2
description: Perform the complex with two kettlebells, executing exercises sequentially without resting between them. The complex is designed to develop strength, muscular endurance, explosive power, and full-body coordination.

title: Double Kettlebell Complex No. 3
description: Perform the complex without resting between exercises. Sequential execution allows you to simultaneously develop strength, muscular endurance, explosive power, and full-body coordination.

title: Single Kettlebell Complex №1
description: Perform the complex with one kettlebell without resting between exercises. After completing the complex, switch arms and repeat the sequence on the other side.

title: Full-Body Barbell Complex
description: Perform the complex with a barbell without resting between exercises. Sequentially execute barbell push-ups, deadlifts, bent-over rows, and a combination of clean, squat, and overhead press.

title: Barbell Complex No. 2
description: Perform the complex with a barbell without resting between exercises. Each exercise begins with a barbell push-up, immediately followed by an additional strength movement.
